scope.goal: Track framework workflow readiness for productization.

cases.productGap: Actual Vite 8.2.0 worker-backed product runtime now covers install artifacts, hydrated dependency materialization, actual Vite CLI dev server start, browser preview relay, real Vite import-analysis transform, React bare package import rewrite, TypeScript/TSX transform fallback, real Vite HMR connected/update payloads, actual Vite build dist artifact generation, and worker bridge reload recovery. Secondary Vue/Svelte product candidates remain partial-pass and keep PG11 open.

Deferred from the first product-supported framework set. The browser guest runtime Vite product workflow adapter covers Vue runtime install artifacts, node_modules/.bin/vite CLI entrypoint materialization/resolution, package.json script-driven dev/build entrypoints, RuntimeChildProcess-backed loopback dev-server lifecycle, Vite-like HTTP module serving, preview relay fetch, source edit/HMR state preservation, Vite wire-compatible HMR connected/update payloads, HMR client update events, and build/dist smoke for npm and pnpm. Product-supported promotion requires an actual Vite worker-backed Vue runtime validation pass.

Deferred from the first product-supported framework set. The browser guest runtime Vite product workflow adapter covers Svelte install artifacts, node_modules/.bin/vite CLI entrypoint materialization/resolution, package.json script-driven dev/build entrypoints, RuntimeChildProcess-backed loopback dev-server lifecycle, Vite-like HTTP module serving, preview relay fetch, source edit/HMR state preservation, Vite wire-compatible HMR connected/update payloads, HMR client update events, and build/dist smoke for npm and pnpm. Product-supported promotion requires actual Svelte plugin/module execution and real Vite server HMR validation.

gate.reason: The first product-supported framework set is Vite React. It passes through actual Vite worker-backed dev, preview, edit/HMR, build/dist, and reload recovery. Vue runtime and Svelte remain reference/adapter-proven secondary candidates and are explicitly deferred to public limitations until product-supported actual worker-backed validation is added.
requiredToPass: Keep Vite React product-supported evidence green
Keep Vue runtime and Svelte documented as deferred secondary framework candidates
Reopen framework gate if Vue/Svelte are promoted into the product-supported framework set
